prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished transparent HERO ILLUSTRATION for a playful mobile game home screen. Portrait about 2:3, clear actual RGBA transparent background, not a whole UI and not a sprite sheet.

Subject: ONE delightfully ridiculous vertical stack of THREE expressive household objects, carefully touching each other, exactly in this bottom-to-top order:
1. Bottom: a large vivid cobalt/sky-blue PLASTIC STORAGE BIN with a fitted chunky lid, molded rim, small side latches and beveled edges. It has a clearly visible happy expressive face on the large front panel: one big white eye with black pupil, one playful winking eye, rosy pink cheeks, and an open dark smiling mouth with a little pink tongue. This is a blue rectangular household storage box, NOT cardboard, NOT a treasure chest. Angle the bin slightly clockwise to the right, like the funny foundation of an unlikely stack.
2. Middle: a smaller white CERAMIC TOILET, with a visible rectangular water tank behind and a rounded bowl/seat projecting forward/right, complete compact pedestal. The tank front has two curved smiling eyes and a small delighted mouth, little soft pink cheeks. Its tank and bowl proportions must clearly read as a toilet. Lean this toilet gently in the opposite direction from the blue bin, rested directly on the lid, no wooden separators. A charming recognizable object with a face, not a human body.
3. Top: a bright yellow RUBBER DUCK, large enough to read, sitting directly on top of the toilet tank. Puffy rounded body, raised small wing, round head, cheerful black eyes with tiny clean highlights, orange open smiling beak pointing toward the LEFT. A classical duck bath toy with premium smooth yellow rubber/plastic volume. Keep the duck's head clear and fully shown. Nothing is placed above it in this asset because a separate existing red slipper sprite will later be overlaid touching the duck's head.

Style and mood: match a high-quality brightly colored 2.5D casual game home illustration. Funny, expressive, energetic, friendly, polished, charmingly precarious but contacting. A gentle alternating left/right visual rhythm, not a stiff straight product display. Strong readable silhouettes, larger faces, clean broad bevel highlights, soft coherent upper-left light, small believable contact shadows. Rich BLUE / WHITE / YELLOW blocks. Blue bin feels plastic, toilet feels glazed ceramic, duck feels rubber. No grunge or noisy textures, no realistic bathroom, no photography, no plush blanket look, no forced material sameness. Clean expressive game illustration quality, no flat clip art and no emoji faces.

Composition: show the ENTIRE assembled stack including the full bin bottom and complete duck head. Three quarter view matching a friendly mobile game hero, central vertical composition, occupy most height with 8 percent transparent safety padding. No clipping of any side, no detached object, no floating gap at contacts. The bin is the widest object, toilet medium, duck somewhat narrower. Stack as one final decorative home illustration, not three disconnected assets.

Hard exclusions: NO slippers or shoes in this generated image, NO basketball, fridge, paper/cardboard box, people, human limbs, cats, platform/pedestal, scenery, ground plane, cloud, sky, title, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, frame or checkerboard. Transparent background with clean antialiased edges and real alpha. No painted floor shadow rectangle. Only the expressive blue bin + smiling white toilet + happy yellow duck stack.
purpose: Home-only expressive blue plastic box, toilet and rubber duck illustration. User explicitly requested original UI composition. Formal slipper overlaid separately.

formal_slipper.role: Prefer and reuse formal facial red slipper; no redraw, no gameplay pool change
